## Purpose
This exercise demonstrates basic R syntax by creating variables, performing calculations, and using logical comparisons to manage a simple puppy budget.

## Inputs

The script uses a sample hometown, name, height, number of puppies, puppy price, and a budget of $1,000.

```{r}
# Exercise 1: Practice with Basic R Syntax

hometown <- "Windsor"
my_name <- "Alex"
my_height <- 65

puppies <-3
puppy_price <- 300

total_cost <- puppies * puppy_price
too_expensive <- total_cost > 1000
max_puppies <- 1000 %/% puppy_price
```

## Outputs

The script calculates the total cost of the puppies, checks if the cost exceeds $1,000, and determines how many puppies can be purchased within the budget.
